mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. Conditions are currently overcast near Verona Area High School with a temperature of 71 degrees and an air quality index of 52. We are under a waning crescent moon tonight, and you should prepare for an overnight low of 64 degrees with rain in the forecast.

Regarding city business, the City of Verona continues to contract with AECOM Inc. for professional engineering services, ensuring that detailed reports are presented at each city council meeting to keep our infrastructure projects on track.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's, and mark your calendars for Girls Try Hockey this Saturday.
In our weekly police report, a notable incident occurred on Thursday, July 31st, when an officer stopped a vehicle for equipment violations and arrested the driver for O W I.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Really Reese's. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by soon to get your scoop before they close.
